tooltip.waystone_wings.elytra.purpose: Used to craft the Calibrated Warp Core.
waystone_wings.configuration.title: Waystone Wings Configuration
config.waystone_wings.section.flight.too: Control every path that could start or maintain Elytra gliding.
config.waystone_wings.disableFlight.tool: Prevents players from starting or continuing Elytra gliding in every dimension.
config.waystone_wings.disableFireworkBoo: Stops firework rockets from being used to bypass the flight restriction.
Control chest-slot insertion and safe handling of Elytras that are already equipped.
config.waystone_wings.disableEquipping.t: Rejects Elytra insertion into the chest equipment slot without consuming the item.
config.waystone_wings.handleAlreadyEquip: Select how the server handles an Elytra found in a player's chest slot. Unequip returns it to inventory or drops it safely when inventory is full.
config.waystone_wings.section.notificati: Configure the throttled action-bar message shown after a blocked flight attempt.
Displays an action-bar explanation when the mod blocks an attempt to glide or boost.
config.waystone_wings.warningCooldownSec: Minimum number of seconds before the same player can receive another flight warning.
config.waystone_wings.flightWarningMessa: The server-controlled action-bar message. It must contain between 1 and 128 characters.
config.waystone_wings.section.infrastruc: Configure the progression for Waystones, Portstones, Sharestones, Warp Plates, and related infrastructure.
config.waystone_wings.replaceWaystonesRe: Uses the Waystone Wings recipe progression instead of the original Waystones infrastructure recipes. The Recipe Style section decides between Create machinery and the vanilla crafting table.
Recipe changes take effect after the world or server is restarted.
config.waystone_wings.requireElytraWarpC: Uses an Elytra as the Calibrated Warp Core input. When disabled, the alternate recipe uses a Nether Star.
Recipe changes take effect after the world or server is restarted.
config.waystone_wings.section.itemRecipe: Configure the replacement recipes for scrolls, dust, shards, the Twinbound Feather, and the Epitaph. The Warp Stone keeps its original Waystones recipe.
config.waystone_wings.replaceWaystonesIt: Extends the overhaul beyond permanent infrastructure to the broader Waystones item set.
Recipe changes take effect after the world or server is restarted.
config.waystone_wings.section.recipeStyl: Choose whether the replacement recipes use Create machinery or the vanilla crafting table. Create is optional: without it every recipe uses the crafting table.
config.waystone_wings.defaultRecipeStyle: Auto uses Create recipes when Create is installed and vanilla crafting-table recipes otherwise. Create forces Create recipes and falls back to vanilla when Create is missing. Vanilla always uses crafting-table recipes, even with Create installed.
Recipe changes take effect after the world or server is restarted.
config.waystone_wings.section.recipeStyl: Force Create or vanilla crafting for the recipes that support both. Default follows the Default Recipe Style. Portstones, Sharestones, Warp/Return/Portal Scrolls, the Twinbound Feather, and the Epitaph are always crafted at a table and have no override here.
config.waystone_wings.recipeStyle.calibr: Crafting style for the Calibrated Warp Core, which gates all Waystones infrastructure.
Recipe changes take effect after the world or server is restarted.
config.waystone_wings.recipeStyle.waysto: Crafting style for the plain Waystone.
Recipe changes take effect after the world or server is restarted.
Crafting style for the mossy, sandy, deepslate, blackstone, end stone, prismarine, purpur, mud brick, and red nether brick Waystones.
Recipe changes take effect after the world or server is restarted.
config.waystone_wings.recipeStyle.warpPl: Crafting style for the Warp Plate.
Recipe changes take effect after the world or server is restarted.
config.waystone_wings.recipeStyle.blankS: Crafting style for Blank Scrolls. Warp, Return, and Portal Scrolls are always crafted at a table from a Blank Scroll.
Recipe changes take effect after the world or server is restarted.
config.waystone_wings.recipeStyle.warpDu: Crafting style for Warp Dust. The Create recipe uses crushing wheels.
Recipe changes take effect after the world or server is restarted.
config.waystone_wings.recipeStyle.dorman: Recipe changes take effect after the world or server is restarted.
config.waystone_wings.recipeStyle.deepsl: Crafting style for Deepslate Shards. The Create recipe uses a mechanical press.
Recipe changes take effect after the world or server is restarted.
config.waystone_wings.section.compatibil: Fallback controls for modpacks and external data packs that need the original recipe progression.
config.waystone_wings.allowOriginalRecip: Restores recreated versions of all original Waystones recipes as an emergency compatibility mode.
Enabling this disables the Waystone Wings replacement recipes and requires a world or server restart.
config.waystone_wings.section.identity.t: Configure the client-side name of the vanilla Elytra item.
config.waystone_wings.renameElytra.toolt: Displays the vanilla Elytra as the Elytra Warp Core while preserving the underlying item and its data.
config.waystone_wings.section.tooltips.t: Configure the extra player guidance shown beneath the Elytra Warp Core's normal tooltip.
config.waystone_wings.showPurposeTooltip: Adds concise flight-restriction and Waystones progression lines without removing vanilla durability information.
config.waystone_wings.section.appearance: Configure the custom 16x16 inventory model and texture.
config.waystone_wings.useWarpCoreTexture: Replaces only the Elytra inventory model with the Waystone Wings dimensional-core artwork.
A game restart is required because item models are baked during client startup.
